title: The metal insets
offscreen: Cut the shapes out of cardboard and use them as stencils: draw round them with a pencil, then fill them with parallel lines without going over the edge.

rounds.label: rectangle
rounds.say: two long sides, two short ones

rounds.label: trapezium
rounds.say: wide at the bottom, narrow at the top

intro.bo: Shall we try together, {nome}? If we get it wrong, the material tells us by itself.
intro.pilu: Look carefully, {nome}: I don't need to tell you if it's right here. You can see it yourself.
intro.tango: Come on, {nome}! You can make as many mistakes as you like here: you see it straight away and try again.

outro.bo: We did it, {nome}. If you like, you can do this one with real things too.
outro.pilu: Well done, {nome}. The same thing exists with real objects: ask a grown-up.
outro.tango: Done! {nome}, shall we do it with real things tomorrow? I'll bring my paws.
